title: Wedge Antilles
description: WEDGE ANTILLES in an X-Wing Fighter and Lando Calrissian in the Millennium Falcon reach the main reactor of the half-finished Death Star and bombard the power regulator and main reactor with proton torpedoes, setting off a chain reaction that will doom the Empire's "impregnable" weapon. The production painting by Ralph McQuarrie (front) can only begin to hint at the power of the scene, as the ships barely escape before the battle station erupts into a super nova.
